summary: Executed backend+frontend validation for Admin Customer Intelligence campaign templates, metrics, radar history, auth gates, and CORS preflight. Backend feature flows passed including template creation and template-based radar action application with persisted template_id. External preview CORS preflight remains blocked by edge interception; frontend customer-intelligence UI automation was blocked by selector mismatch in rendered admin shell.

critical.issue: External preflight still returns wildcard CORS (access-control-allow-origin: *) and omits access-control-allow-credentials=true; local FastAPI endpoint returns explicit origin + credentials correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Automation could not reach customer-intelligence tab using expected selectors/text; rendered admin shell appears different from expected DOM contract for tested selectors.

action_items: Fix/align preview edge ingress CORS for credentialed OPTIONS so external preflight matches app contract (explicit origin + allow-credentials=true).
Verify deployed admin shell exposes stable data-testid hooks for customer-intelligence navigation, then re-run UI flow for template create/apply and timeline confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend overview response includes campaign_templates, campaign_metrics, and radar_history as requested with no _id/ObjectId serialization leaks in tested payloads.

POST /api/admin/customer-intelligence/radar/templates and template-based POST /api/admin/customer-intelligence/radar/action flow works end-to-end; action.template_id persisted and history endpoint returns matching entries with metrics.
Auth gates behave correctly for unauth/non-admin across overview, radar action, templates, and history endpoints.

success_rate.frontend: 20% (admin page load/login only; target tab flow blocked)

seed_data_creation: Created QA radar template and multiple radar actions (coupon/push/manager_alert/coupon_push_alert) against existing user data during automated tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression is strong and can be reused from updated test_admin_customer_intelligence.py. For UI, preview currently renders an admin shell where expected customer-intelligence selectors/text were not discoverable by Playwright despite successful admin login; start by inventorying live DOM testids in /admin before attempting customer-intelligence assertions.
rca of the issue: CORS failure reproduces only on external preview URL where Cloudflare/edge answers OPTIONS with wildcard and no credentials header. Local FastAPI OPTIONS on localhost:8001 returns explicit allow-origin and allow-credentials=true, indicating infrastructure interception/override before backend app middleware.
